scope: Short hidden-actor background diagnostics, not visible gameplay or long-duration performance. Same host but live Temp counts and measurement windows differ. Buffer allocation reduction alone did not materially reduce CPU. Final 24-second run includes complete scan/rest/restart cycles.

runs.scope: Fresh private mortal background-only x1; normal production controller/timer, actors invisible and zero presented frames, all maintenance off. Observe may read real Temp. Virtual has two initial ambient opponents; Observe scene depends on census. No input/capture/native maintenance. CPU is own-process CPU; PerfProbe sections are UI wall time, not thread CPU. Samples stay in memory; one final JSON write.
